policy: Clear bags that do not exceed 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutch purses (no larger than 4.5" x 6.5") are permitted. All other bags, including backpacks, are strictly prohibited.
Strollers are permitted but must be folded and placed under your seat or checked at Guest Services near Gate A. They cannot block aisles.
Outside food and beverages are not allowed, except for one factory-sealed water bottle (up to 20 oz) per guest.
Gourmet Burgers and Fries are available at 'The Grill' located near Section 106 and 'Stadium Bites' near Section 212.
Vegan and vegetarian options, including plant-based burgers and salads, are available exclusively at 'Green Goal' near Section 115.
Free high-speed Wi-Fi is available to all guests. Connect to the network 'Stadia_Free_WiFi' and accept the terms of service on the login page.
This is a completely smoke-free facility. Smoking, including e-cigarettes and vaping, is strictly prohibited everywhere inside the stadium.
Lost and Found is located at the main Guest Services desk behind Section 101. Items are kept for 30 days.
